title: Multiple active proposals require user selection

initial_state.description: Two complete active proposals and one incomplete directory are present.

allowed_tool_calls.description: Use CLI list to discover active candidates.

required_observations.description: The Agent presents the valid candidates and asks for a short name.

forbidden_side_effects.description: The Agent selects or mutates one candidate without user choice.

assertions: Archive and incomplete directories are not offered as valid candidates.

outcome.description: The user is asked to choose among valid candidates.

process.description: CLI list supplies the candidate set.
